title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
**Date posted:** 9 september 2026

**Pay:** ₹15,000\.00\-₹25,000\.00 per month

**Job Description:**

About Sky Education Group

Sky Education Group is an education counselling and enrollment partner working with 28\+ universities across India. We help students and working professionals choose the right Online \& Distance UG and PG programmes based on their academic background, career goals and requirements.

We are looking for a Business Development Executive who has already worked/willing to start their career in the Online/Distance Higher Education / EdTech admission sales domain and can start handling leads with minimal training.

Fresher/Experience both can apply for this role.

We are specifically looking for candidates who already understand:

* Online \& Distance Education
* UG \& PG admission counselling
* University/course comparison
* B2C lead handling
* Telephonic counselling
* Follow\-up and objection handling
* Admission conversion
* CRM/lead management
* Closing the admission cycle

Key Responsibilities

* Handle **fresh and existing leads** through telephone calls, WhatsApp and other communication channels.
* Understand the student's **education, career goals, work experience and course requirements**.
* Counsel students for Online \& Distance UG/PG programmes such as:
* **BBA**
* **BCA**
* **B.Com**
* **MBA**
* **MCA**
* Other relevant UG/PG programmes
* Explain and compare universities, programmes, eligibility, fees, admission process and other relevant details.
* Counsel students regarding programmes offered through leading universities such as **NMIMS, LPU, Amity, Chandigarh University, Manipal University** and other partner universities.
* Handle student objections related to **fees, university selection, course validity, programme structure, placements, admission process and competitors**.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with interested prospects and move them towards admission.
* Coordinate with the admission/operations team until the student's admission process is successfully completed.
* Maintain accurate lead and follow\-up information in the CRM.
* Achieve **monthly admission and revenue targets**.
* Maintain high\-quality counselling while focusing strongly on **conversion and closures**.

What We Are Looking For Mandatory :

* **0\-2 years of relevant experience** in Online Education / Distance Education / EdTech admission sales will be preferred .
* Have experience selling **Online/Distance UG \& PG programmes will be beneficial** .
* Candidates who have previously worked with **Online University, EdTech, University Enrollment Partner, Education Consultancy or similar organizations** are preferred.
* Strong understanding of the **Online Education admission process**.
* Proven experience in **B2C telephonic counselling and sales conversion but not mandatory**.
* Comfortable handling a high volume of calls and follow\-ups.
* Strong communication skills in **Hindi \& English**.
* Strong convincing, negotiation and objection\-handling ability.
* Comfortable working with sales targets.
* Candidate should be able to **start handling leads with minimal training**.

Who Will Be a Strong Fit?

Someone who has previously worked as:

* Business Development Executive
* Career Counsellor – EdTech
* Inside Sales Executive – EdTech
* Online Education Counsellor
* University Admission Counsellor

and has actually converted Online/Distance Education leads into admissions.

Interview

Face\-to\-Face Interview / Walk\-in

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager Inside Sales
description:
Adobe ICX are a Modern Sales Team of 600\+ Digital sellers, supported by analytics and data science teams. We are integrated with Adobe.com digital marketing \& engagement funnel and are developing capabilities on picking cues from the customers demographic (who) \& behavioral (what) data that they leave on their journey with our business to predict next ‘sales action’ that will lead to revenue conversions (future state).
  
  

**The challenge:**  

We are looking for a Sales Leader who is responsible for leading and directing strategic initiatives that enable the Digital Sales team to continue exceeding the defined sales goals and KPIs across the North Americas territory. You would be responsible for the Creativity \& Productivity (C\&P) portfolio of Adobe.
  
An Ideal candidate would be a thought leader with a proven track record of leading successful sales operations on field or in Digital Sales of reasonable size and possess the ability to turn findings into executable plans. He/She must also be an inspiring leader able to build, develop \& inspire a high performing team.
  
  

**What you’ll do:****As a Leader:**  

Leading team by coaching mentoring \& motivating the team with a high level of EQ \& becoming trusted leader for the team.
  
Should possess strong collaboration skills as the Digital Sellers leverage other teams for their own success
  
Driving the highest level of performance from the team at the same time role modelling \& instilling Adobe values in the team
  
Developing sales strategy and pilot different pitches to continue meeting sales goals, while reducing overall customer cancellations.
  
Building knowledge on Adobe products and services – their features, benefits, prices, and additional services.
  
Developing ways to coach the team to identify customer needs and pitch the relevant product benefits to complete a sale.
  
Working with Marketing, Sales Operation, Business units, Corporate Retention teams to source sales or retention campaigns, marketing leads and execute. Analyze business goals, customer \& agent data \& daily reports to find areas of continuous improvement.
  
Responsible for feedback loop with the worldwide stakeholders on execution and on pilot/test campaigns to improve effectiveness of campaigns.
  
Developing key performance metrics and dashboards that help the sales organization focus on performance drivers.
  
  

**As A Sales Professional:**  

Managing Sales pipeline and regular forecasting to meet assigned goals.
  
Preparing ICX Sales performance reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing sales, data and trends.
  
Developing and continuously improving lead qualification using established criteria and standards.
  
Producing and implementing action\-oriented plans when sales goals or SLAs do not meet expectations.
  
Implementing and reviewing policies, business metrics, productivity and operating structure to consistently grow the sales results.
  
Providing weekly reporting on leads, conversion to qualified prospects, sales opportunities and campaign effectiveness. In addition to revenue and pipeline measurement, each manager will track daily, weekly and monthly activity \& productivity metrics on their teams to ensure the team is spending their time on the highest value add actions at all times.
  
Turning data into insights capable of independently translating ambiguous business problems into specific analyses and capable of translating the resulting data back into a solution to meet the business need.
  
  

What you need to succeed
  
  

10–14\+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Digital Sales, or Customer Success roles (experience level flexible for Manager vs. Senior Manager).
  
Mandatory people management experience across NA markets , including leading managers and/or large frontline teams.
  
  

**Proven expertise across:**  

Strong understanding of digital\-first sales models , funnel management, and data\-driven decision making.
  
Demonstrated ability to define and execute regional strategies that balance scale, efficiency, and customer experience.
  
Experience partnering with Marketing, Operations, Analytics, and Product teams.
  
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presence
  
o Outbound Sales (Leads, RFIs, MQLs)
  
o Customer Success (Retention and Expansion of existing customers)
  
Drive consistent performance management through goal setting, regular cadence reviews, and skill development aligned to regional needs.
  
Working closely with the North American customer in their time zone (working hours would be EDT/EST for North America).
  
Willingness to work across shifts.
  
Ability to compile sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translate the results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations that are digestible for the entire company.
  
Advanced knowledge of Sales Operations, Technology used in Digital sales.
  
Thought leadership on Sales, Customer Success and Subscription management.
  
Proven ability to effectively manage people effectively, hire and train, coach new sales team members.
  
Proven ability to develop a communicate and present to management on new ideas, proposals and feedback to move the business forward.
  
  

About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

description:

title: Sales Engineer
description:
THE ROLE

Direct sale of CPL's odorisation and gas skid range to end customers across India, against an individual order booking target. The role covers the full cycle: generating enquiries, preparing techno commercial offers, bidding, negotiating and closing orders. We are looking for a self\-driven professional who will open new accounts on his or her own initiative, not someone who works only on enquiries received.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Generate new enquiries and develop new accounts through direct customer visits, references, tender portals such as GeM and CPPP, and industry networks. Target segments are city gas distribution companies, compressed biogas and LNG project developers, EPC contractors and industrial gas users.** 

Build and maintain a pipeline sufficient to meet the annual order booking target, updated in the company CRM.

**Prepare techno commercial offers with datasheets, deviation statements and priced bills of quantity, in coordination with engineering and production, ensuring compliance with PNGRB, OISD, BIS, ASME and hazardous area requirements.** 

Submit bids complete and on time, follow up on offers, handle technical and commercial queries, negotiate and close orders.

**Act as the customer's principal contact until order placement, including presentations, plant visits and commercial discussions, and support collections and after sales matters thereafter.** 

Develop repeat business from the installed base through odorant, spares and service contracts.

**Track competitor activity, pricing trends and upcoming CGD and CBG projects, and report to management. Represent CPL at exhibitions and industry forums.** 

**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 

B.E. or B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering, with 5 to 8 years in the sale of engineered to order equipment. Odorisation systems, DRS, MRS or CGS skids, metering skids or pressure vessels preferred.

**Proven record of selling directly to end customers and closing orders against target.** 

Working knowledge of public and private sector tendering, including GeM and e\-procurement portals.

**Able to read P\&IDs, drawings and datasheets independently and hold a technical discussion with the customer's engineers without support.** 

Sound grasp of costing, margins, payment terms and contract conditions such as liquidated damages, bank guarantees and price variation. **S**

**self\-driven, persistent through long sales cycles, and willing to travel extensively across India.** 

Fluent in English and Hindi, with the maturity to represent the company independently before senior customer personnel.

**Comfortable with MS Office, CRM and ERP systems.**

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹130,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
